# ascii-magic-art (vendored)

Subset of [ascii-magic-art](https://github.com/kailashsr38/ascii-magic-art) **v1.0.2** (MIT). Copied from the published npm package, unmodified. Nothing on this page loads from a CDN or from ascii-magic.com.

- `runtime/` — canvas player, glyph looks, and the `<ascii-art>` element
- `lib/kit.js` — drawing toolkit imported by the piece
- `pieces/viaduct-steam-train.js` — Viaduct Steam Train

`ascii-sharks.html` plays the piece with `play()` from `runtime/player.js`. The piece’s own `meta.look` is `dots` (halftone circles on black, warm landscape palette), which is the default on the [piece page](https://www.ascii-magic.com/ascii/viaduct-steam-train).
